title: OPEC+ Output Signals Spur Options Bets Oil Will Lurch Below $60
summary: A flurry of bets on Brent crude falling below $60 a barrel this year changed hands in recent days, a sign investors are hedging against the risk of another large production hike from OPEC and its allies.
